planet.name: Next Island
planet.summary: Next Island starts newcomers at Paradise Landing with free starter gear and a Strider vehicle from Resa Docks. Its dailies pay Elysian Tech Chips, crystals and blueprints, and lead into long VIP routes. The linked time-travel area Ancient Greece has its own file.
planet.howToReach: Virtualsense's Yamato shared warp (6 PED per paying passenger), a Kronan request stop, a token teleport (6 station-to-station or 10 planet-to-planet Teleportation Tokens on eligible links since 19.2.0), or your own ship.
warnings: Desk-checked from public sources only; in-game field verification is pending.
The Next Island forum would not load during research; official 18.12 notes were read via search-index copies and cross-checked with NI Helper.
Starter gear eligibility after Setesh, item cargo flags and all timer triggers are unconfirmed.
Space routes can cross lootable PvP zones. Leave valuables in storage.

activities.title: Get to Next Island
activities.summary: Use a shared warp when its fare and return timing suit you, or a token teleport. Virtualsense's Yamato route stops at Next Island for 6 PED per paying passenger, and Kronan lists it as a request stop.
steps: Shared warp: check the Virtualsense Yamato schedule (November 2026 has event-specific shifts) or ask Kronan for a request stop. Follow the operator's boarding and cargo instructions.
Token teleport: since 19.2.0 the published fare is 6 Teleportation Tokens station-to-station or 10 planet-to-planet on eligible links. 150 kg cap.
The station-to-own-planet fee was removed in 18.9, so the older 7 PED figure in the NI Academy page no longer applies.
Leave valuable lootables in storage if flying through lootable PvP.

cost.text: 6 PED Yamato passenger fare, or 6/10 Teleportation Tokens on eligible links.

currencies.name: Teleportation Token
currencies.note: 6 station-to-station or 10 planet-to-planet on eligible links.

score.rationale: Required first step; cheap by tokens or shared warp.

warnings: Shared-warp schedules shift around events; check the operator's current post.
Lootable PvP zones in space can cost you cargo.

activities.title: Starter missions at Paradise Landing
activities.summary: The starter buildings down on the beach at Paradise Landing offer hunting, mining and crafting missions that hand out a gun and ammo, a finder, probes and a refiner, and a healing tool. The roof chef also has a gathering mission.
steps: Go to the starter buildings on the beach at Paradise Landing (new avatars spawn there since 18.5; from the Paradise Landing TP, walk down the older path).
Do the hunting, mining and crafting welcome missions.
Do the roof chef's gathering mission if convenient.
rewards: Finder, probes and refiner (refiner is untradeable)

locations.label: Starter buildings on the beach, Paradise Landing

score.rationale: First stop in the recommended route; free starter gear.

warnings: Current starter gear eligibility after the Setesh onboarding change is unverified.

activities.title: Visit Resa Docks (Strider Mk.I vehicle)
activities.summary: Head to Crystal Peak, then north past L.A.R.A. and C.A.R.A. to the Cartographer, and do Visit Resa Docks for the Strider Mk.I (L). Then do the driving mission on the black track near Crystal Peak before driving near aggressive creatures.
steps: Go to Crystal Peak, then north past L.A.R.A. and C.A.R.A. to the Cartographer.
Complete Visit Resa Docks and collect the Strider Mk.I (L).
Do the driving mission on the black track near Crystal Peak.

score.rationale: Free transport early in the recommended route.

activities.title: Sebastian: 200 Mountain Boar Piglets
activities.summary: Kill 200 eligible Mountain Boar Piglets for Sebastian for 1,600 Elysian Tech Chips. A player guide used the fenced group around 137708, 83319.
steps: Talk to Sebastian (waypoint below).
Kill 200 eligible Mountain Boar Piglets (a fenced group around 137708, 83319 was used in a player guide).
Hand in.

cost.text: Ammo and decay for 200 low-level kills.

currencies.name: Elysian Tech Chips
currencies.note: Material; reserve for N.E.O. access or crafting.

cooldown.resetNote: Daily; exact timer and trigger pending. NI Helper reports 20 h for most older dailies, but this mission's own clock is not confirmed.

score.rationale: Top of the recommended repeatable list; cheap low-level targets.

activities.title: Sebastian: 200 Puny Screechers
activities.summary: A second offer from Sebastian, added in 18.12.0: kill 200 Puny Screechers for 1,600 Elysian Tech Chips.
steps: Take the separate Screecher offer from Sebastian.
Kill 200 Puny Screechers and hand in.
Check whether both Sebastian options can be active at once.

currencies.name: Elysian Tech Chips
currencies.note: Material; reserve for N.E.O. access or crafting.

cooldown.resetNote: Daily; exact timer and trigger pending. NI Helper reports 20 h for most older dailies, but this mission's own clock is not confirmed.

activities.title: Multi-Faction Daily (2419-Juliana)
activities.summary: 2419-Juliana at Crystal Peak, and at her other hubs including the Ancient Greece market, lets you pick one faction and one hunting, mining or crafting assignment per daily cycle. The reward is a choice of limited-click clothing or texture blueprints.
steps: Find 2419-Juliana at Crystal Peak or another hub (one is near Ancient Greece market around 36234, 20284).
Choose one faction and one hunting, mining or crafting assignment.
If you stack it with other missions, match the exact creature. The player example (50 Arges) is much tougher than base Cyclops.
rewards: Choice of limited-click clothing or texture blueprint (five clicks per Nexus listing)

cooldown.resetNote: Daily; exact timer and trigger pending. NI Helper reports 20 h for most older dailies, but this mission's own clock is not confirmed. Confirm the trigger in game.

score.rationale: Third in the recommended order; blueprints feed the Haruspex VIP route.

activities.title: Crystal Hoarder (Hiresh)
activities.summary: Accept Crystal Hoarder from Hiresh before your Ancient Greece trip, pick a Greek creature option, then turn it in at Hiresh for a choice of crystals. It also counts toward access to the Resa VIP.
steps: Accept from Hiresh (waypoint below) before travelling to Ancient Greece.
Choose a Greek creature option (a player guide used base Cyclops around Ancient Greece 35204, 19703).
Return to Hiresh to hand in.

cost.text: Travel to Ancient Greece and ammo for the chosen creature.
cost.markupNote: Pick the crystal for a planned recipe or current market.

cooldown.resetNote: Daily; exact timer and trigger pending. NI Helper reports 20 h for most older dailies, but this mission's own clock is not confirmed. Target count per option also needs checking.

score.rationale: Fourth in the recommended order; also opens a VIP route.

warnings: Exact timer and target count per option need checking.

activities.title: Daily Stalker Challenge (Cecily)
activities.summary: Cecily near 127493, 82784 asks for Red Papoo Stalker kills for 2.5 PED of Universal Ammo. In one firsthand run, kills only counted when finished with the E.A.C. Laspistol (L) from the nearby building, after softening the target with another weapon.
steps: Take Daily Stalker Challenge from Cecily near 127493, 82784.
Get the E.A.C. Laspistol (L) from the nearby building.
Damage Red Papoo Stalkers with your own weapon, then finish them with the Laspistol.

cost.text: Ammo for L8 targets plus the weapon restriction.

cooldown.resetNote: Daily; exact timer and trigger pending. NI Helper reports 20 h for most older dailies, but this mission's own clock is not confirmed. Check the current reset in the journal.

score.rationale: Fifth in the recommended order; weapon restriction and L8 target raise cost.

warnings: Exact kill count and the weapon rule come from one player run.

Craft 50 Lesser Elysia with the Technician tailoring blueprint.
Hand in.
rewards: Textiles skill, about 0.4 PED per the player guide

cooldown.resetNote: Daily; exact timer and trigger pending. NI Helper reports 20 h for most older dailies, but this mission's own clock is not confirmed.

score.rationale: Sixth in the recommended order; small skill reward.

activities.title: How Next Island daily timers work
activities.summary: NI Helper reports 20 h for most older dailies, 1 h for Daily Scouting Resources, and 168 h from acceptance for weeklies. Use a mission's own clock when known, and do not assume newer Thebes missions follow the generic duration.
steps: Note acceptance, completion and hand-in times for each daily you do.
warnings: Generic timers come from a community site and do not apply to newer Thebes missions.

activities.title: Use Elysian Tech Chips and crystals
activities.summary: Chips and crystals are materials. Keep chips for N.E.O. access or crafting, and pick Crystal Hoarder crystals for a planned recipe or the current market. Choosing blueprint drops and chips is a different decision from taking ammo.
steps: Decide on a recipe or VIP goal before choosing crystal rewards.
Reserve chips for N.E.O. access or crafting.

activities.title: VIP lounges and SVIP
activities.summary: Next Island has several VIP routes. The shortest documented one is Haruspex at Flora in Tanzanite View. All five VIPs plus Islander status open the later Thebes SVIP area.
steps: Haruspex (Flora, Tanzanite View): attempt each appropriate non-colorable faction garment three times using Multi-Faction Daily blueprints.
Resa (Glenn, Kamba Outpost): starts after Crystal Hoarder; needs 2,000 harvest points, 300 fruit, 100 stones, 50 dung and 5 PED TT of refining.
Stel: 500 shirt attempts and 1,000 exact-name Island Sharks plus mining (longer).
N.E.O.: consumes crafted pieces and Elysian Tech Chips.
Loyalist Peyton: checks a mission record; the community guide is unsure of the full qualifying list.
All five VIPs plus Islander status open the Thebes SVIP area. Magical Flowers gates an extra SVIP task.
Keep unique blueprints while following any route.
rewards: Thebes SVIP area once all five VIPs and Islander are done
requirementsText: Haruspex VIP: blueprints from the Multi-Faction Daily (next-island-multi-faction)
Resa VIP: Crystal Hoarder done first
SVIP: Becoming an Islander (see the Ancient Greece file)

cost.text: Materials, crafting attempts, chips and hunting/mining effort; Resa needs 5 PED TT of refining.

score.rationale: Long late-game track with large material costs.

warnings: The full qualifying list for Loyalist Peyton is uncertain.
18.12.1 fixed incorrect free access to VIP areas.
